name: Ca thieu tam
summary: Cá thiều tẩm is seasoned dried fish in long yellow strips, a Da Nang snack on the 2 Oct 2021 city page. The same page calls the fish a freshwater fish and a Mekong Delta specialty, and it prints two sizes: about two fingers across, and about 4–7 kg.
origin: The seasoned strips are a Da Nang specialty on the 2 Oct 2021 city page, made with Nam Ô fish sauce, pepper, and white sugar. The fish itself is also called a Mekong Delta specialty on the same page.
texture: The strips are yellow, about 10–15 cm, and the page says the grilled meat is both chewy and soft.
taste: The page says the grilled fish is sweet and fragrant, with a salty-sweet strip and the heat of pepper. Nam Ô fish sauce is the seasoning it names.
howToEat: Eat the strips from the packet, which the page says needs no further cooking, or grill them.
The page says the fish is skinned, sliced thin, cut into pieces, mixed for about half an hour, and sun-dried from two days to a week depending on the sun, then cut into strips.
where: Supermarkets and specialty shops in Da Nang, on the 2 Oct 2021 page. A restaurant door is not named. Check on arrival for a cooked plate.
priceBand: A 250 g box is 100,000–120,000 đồng on the 2 Oct 2021 page. A cooked plate is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ca thieu tam — seasoned dried fish from Da Nang
seoDescription: Cá thiều tẩm is a yellow dried-fish strip from Da Nang, eaten from the packet or grilled. A 250 g box is 100,000–120,000 đồng. The page prints two fish sizes.
